Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) 1. The bidder/service provider must be registered in West Bengal, and the register ed address of the bidder must be located in Kolkata. 2. The bidder should have experience of providing/running vehicles to Governme nt Departments/ Offices, or as otherwise specified in the GeM Bid. 3. The vendor must put the vehicle at designated parking facility for the vehicles and the vehicles cannot be put to use for other purpose . 4. The vehicles may be required to be deployed anywhere within the jurisdictiona

l territory of the Pr. Chief Commissioner of Income Tax-West Bengal & Sikkim. 5. The drivers provided with the vehicles must be conversant with Google Maps/n avigation applications, possess working knowledge of Bengali and any other lang uage must be courteous, disciplined and well mannered in their conduct. 6 . Certified copies of the Registration Certificate (RC), valid Insurance Certificate, Pollution Under Control (PUC) Certificate, GST Certificate of the vendor , Driving Licences and Aadhar Cards of the vendor and drivers, as applicable, shall be uploaded on GeM and shall also be produced at the time of execution/ signing of the contract. 7. The vehicles proposed to be offered for the service shall be produced before t he Department for physical inspection at the Office of the Pr.CIT (AU)-4, Kolkata, A ayakar Bhawan P-7 Chowringhee Square, Kolkata 700069, at the time of evaluatio n of the technical bids. 8. Bidders are advised to ascertain the applicable rate of GST before quoting their bids. The Department shall not be responsible for any incorrect GST calculation by the bidder. GST reimbursement shall be made at the actual applicable rate or the rate quouted by the bidder, whichever is lower, subject to the maximu m GST rate quoted in the bid. 9. The vehicles offered for the service shall comply with all necessary laws and regulations. 10. The bidder/ service provider must not have been blacklisted/ debarred by any Central Government, S tate Government, Government Organization or Public Sector Undertaking, as on the date of submission of the bid. The bidder must submit self declaration on Judicial Stamp Paper for confirming satisfactory service throughout the contract period. 11. The bidder shall disclose adverse performance record, complaint or unsatisfactory service record rela ting to services previously provided to the Department, if any adverse review come to the knowledge of th e Purchase Committee during the bidding procedure, the bidder is liable to be rejected without showing an y reason further. 12. The Vehicles shall be available for use 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, as and when required for official purposes, without assigning any reason or prior intimation. 13. The duration of the service contract may be extended by a period of up to six (6) months beyond the i nitial contract period at the same rates, subject to satisfactory performance and in accordance with the ap plicable terms and conditions. 14. The bidders must upload all necessary and relevant documents in legible scanned copied in respect of the vehicles offered for the service, including the relevant agreement/ lease documents where the bidde r proposes to provide vehicles taken on rent/ lease. 15. The decision of the Tender Evaluation Committee shall be final with regard to the evaluation of the tec hnical bids, subject to the applicable provisions of the tender/ Gem Bid. 16. The financial bids of only those bidders who are found technically responsive/ qualified shall be open ed. 17. Preference will be given to vendors with good service record, good make/model/condition of vehicle. D rivers are to be neatly dressed and conversant in more than one language. 5. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support.

6. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 7. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 8.
